newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan oil basket rises $0.03 in wk to $15.93.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan oil basket rises $0.03 in wk to $15.93.

text.p: The average export price for Venezuela's basket of oil crudes and products rose $0.03 to $15.93 on Friday -- a slight recovery after last week's $1.70 drop, figures from the Ministry of Energy and Mines showed.
The price has steadily trended downwards since December last year when it averaged $21.55 per barrel. April's average is so far $15.94, with the average price for the year $18.36, the figures showed.
In 1996, the basket averaged one of the highest prices in recent years at $18.39 per barrel, well up from $14.84 the year before.

Venezuela's government has based its 1997 budget on an average price for the year of $14.00 per barrel, although Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta has said he expects it to average higher than $15.50.
Oil accounts for some 70 percent of government revenue.
